# Map Fairy Tales

> AI-generated fairy tales and folk stories from every corner of the world. Read, create, and share stories inspired by different cultures, countries, and legends.

## What this site offers

- Interactive world map with AI-generated fairy tales for 195+ countries
- Users can create custom stories by providing prompts and cultural context
- Each story is region-specific, drawing on local mythology, folklore, and traditions
- Stories can be translated into the local language using AI
- Community features: likes, ratings, comments, sharing

## Pages

- [Home — Interactive World Map](https://mapfairytales.com/)
- [Explore Stories Feed](https://mapfairytales.com/stories)

## Content types

- AI-generated fairy tales (English, with on-demand translation)
- Cultural folk stories inspired by real mythology
- User-created custom stories with AI assistance
- Region-specific imagery generated alongside stories

## Technology

Built with Next.js, MongoDB, Firebase Auth, and Groq AI (Llama 3.1).
Story generation uses structured prompts with cultural context per country.
